reason: PURE. The first thing I saw was "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR code, and then the named ISO 17025 lab and no magnesium oxide. Citrate wrecks my stomach, so I would skip the Complex and try one box of the bisglycinate for sleep and leg cramps.
objection: No reviews and a brand I have never heard of. It is not NSF or USP certified, so the lab report is only the company's word until I open the QR and see a real report with real numbers for the batch in my box.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report did not open, or showed no lot number matching my box, or listed no heavy metals results, I would put it back and buy an NSF or USP certified brand instead.
